scripts.setup: npm run wrangler:init && npm run cf-typegen
scripts.db:migrations:apply: node scripts/wrangler.mjs d1 migrations apply db_boltlink --remote
scripts.deploy: npm run db:migrations:apply && node scripts/wrangler.mjs deploy
scripts.dev-validate-phase-5: vitest run test/group-hierarchy.spec.ts test/group-hierarchy-admin.spec.ts test/portability-export.spec.ts test/portability-export-admin.spec.ts test/portability-import.spec.ts test/portability-import-admin.spec.ts test/qrcode.spec.ts test/qrcode-admin.spec.ts

TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Cloudflare Access team domain. Use the HTTPS team URL from Zero Trust, for example `https://your-team.cloudflareaccess.com`.

POLICY_AUD.description: Cloudflare Access AUD tag for the self-hosted application that protects `/admin`, `/admin.html`, `/api`, and `/api/*`.

APP_TIMEZONE.description: Application timezone used to interpret scheduling fields (`Ativa em`/`Expira em`) when values are submitted without explicit timezone offset. Default: `America/Sao_Paulo`.

ROOT_REDIRECT_URL.description: Opcional (Text, não Secret; optional, non-secret): URL para redirecionar a raiz `/`. Deixe vazio para manter a página inicial padrão do BoltLink (landing). Use uma URL absoluta http(s) válida: GET / responde 302 com Cache-Control: no-store, sem consultar D1. Disponível no setup inicial do Deploy to Cloudflare. Não afeta unknown slugs (404), /admin, /api, /health ou /privacidade. Também pode ser configurada no dashboard como Text.

API_KEY.description: Optional secret for internal API automation only. Store it as a secret, not as a public `vars` value.

PASSWORD_SESSION_SECRET.description: Required to create or update password-protected links and to serve them after upgrade. Without it, the API and admin refuse to add a password and legacy protected links fail closed with HTTP 503 (GET and POST). Generate a long random value, for example with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Store it as a Worker secret; `API_KEY` is not a fallback. For local development, use `.dev.vars`. For deployed Workers, use the Cloudflare dashboard or `wrangler secret put`.

db_boltlink.description: D1 database used for links and aggregate click counters. The deploy flow can provision it automatically from the Wrangler config.
